clips.caption:
A fitness coach told Kevin Trudeau that almost everyone he tests comes back low on one vitamin: D.

His explanation: most people simply aren't getting enough sun, aren't eating foods that carry it, and aren't supplementing for it - so the gap just sits there, unnoticed, year after year.

His other flag: DHEA, a hormone most people never think to test, sitting right alongside it on a full panel.

When's the last time you actually checked your vitamin D?
